violated_contract: A live STT leg that listen itself cancels (owner close, recovery switch, teardown) is not evidence about the provider. Its death reason must be a bounded, censored token. If it falls outside the bounded reason vocabulary, normalization defaults it to connection_lost, a provider failure that feeds the routing disruption gate and the serving circuit. Since 2026-10-14 Parakeet-window connection_lost at peak rose from about 2% to about 10% of successes, above the 0.08 gate, which benched Parakeet for 10-16 h/day and moved English sessions to Soniox.
canonical_prevention: Every death token a serving socket latches must be a member of LIVE_STT_REASONS, and a listen-initiated cause must be classified as censored by provider_observation. Cover it with a behavioral test that cancels a real window leg mid-POST, settles the failover, and asserts a censored observation with no gate state, alongside tests that a self-ended pump and an unknown free-text reason still count as connection_lost.
